records.title: Ober Ost troop-movement proposal, conditional obliteration exclusion
records.header_literal: B) NKJ v LP (06.23 a.m., November 13th); FUER WAU 07.00 2 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-308
records.readable_german: Gen. Gouv. Warschau. Z0FORT. ?MX1AXNRR6?1X15XGENXVX10X11 ist an OBOST gedrahtet. Es wird vorgeschlagen, Truppenverschiebungen innerhalb des Oberostgebiets vorzunehmen.
records.meaning: The body addresses GEN GOUV WARSCHAU, says that the referenced item has been wired to OBOST, and proposes troop movements within the Ober Ost territory. Z0FORT and the opening reference remain opaque literal fields. The text is a proposal, not evidence that the movements occurred.
notes: The conditional frame excludes two obliterated group-width regions, modeled as five unknown positions each. These are ten masked-slot exclusions, not ten observed-coordinate corrections. Cancellation intent is not proved.
The Y-like glyph in XYVXX is transcribed Y and masked. The middle glyph of FGCGA is ambiguous C/G-shaped, conservatively transcribed C and masked; the proposed G costs one source-mask fill.
VORGESCHLX?EN to VORGESCHLAGEN needs one observed-coordinate substitution and one fill; TRUPPENVERSCHIEBUNG?N to TRUPPENVERSCHIEBUNGEN needs the other fill.
Z0FORT, ?MX1AXNRR6?1X15XGENXVX10X11 and OBOST are retained literally. No date, office reference or expansion of OBOST is imposed.

The first remaining unknown is VG (plaintext index 25); the second is AF (index 35), the same cell as p186 C1 index 11. AF is distinct from GA, which is shared by p186 B2 index 109 and C1 index 9. These linked reference labels remain unassigned.

records.source_layout_note: 318-position composite layout: 308 individually transcribed positions plus two group-width obliterations, each modeled as five masks. The obliterated regions do not preserve five separately countable glyphs each.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier unreviewed repository candidates are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: The two obliterated regions occupy normal five-character group columns. Their ten masks are a disclosed layout model, not ten legible printed coordinate glyphs.
The primary 308-coordinate analysis conditionally excludes both group-width masks; the advertised 308 agrees with this geometry but does not prove historical cancellation.
All 308 individually transcribed positions remain in order. Two ambiguous non-coordinate glyphs are masked and filled explicitly; one observed coordinate changes.
The original 318-position composite model and both single-region exclusions remain diagnostic alternatives. Odd controls retain their unpaired-coordinate provenance.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective; completion witnesses are nonhistorical.
